subject: Model regression after v2.1 rollout - next steps & pin request
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@retailco.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@retailco.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call recap & recommended models / next steps

Thanks again for taking the call earlier, Sam and Alex - good to meet. Quick recap and proposed next steps based on what you shared about the product recommendations use case and latency targets (~200ms tail).

Summary from call:
- Primary goal: inline product recommendations on PDP and cart (low-latency reranking + light generative copy).
- Volume: ~2M calls/day at peak; 95th p50 latency requirement ~200ms for ranked responses.
- Data policy: PII removed at ingestion; enterprise contract required for Dedicated / Private deployment.

Our model recommendations (initial):
- For reranking + short generation: redwood-open-llama-13b-quant (v2.0) - good precision/latency tradeoff for your prompt lengths.
- For higher-quality personalized copy (longer context): redwood-instruct-22b (hosted) as a fall-back for higher-cost routes.

Attached: prompt_set_retailco_v1.jsonl (20 seed prompts you mentioned) and a short benchmark summary link (see Drive link below).

Next steps I propose:
1) Run a small eval with your 20 prompts against v2.0 (current pinned) and v2.1 (recent rollout) - we can provide side-by-side diffs and precision/recall for your relevance metric.
2) If quality is acceptable on v2.1, plan a canary with 10% traffic for 48h.
3) If regressions appear, we can pin back to v2.0 immediately and open a regression investigation with engineering.

I'll run the evaluation and share results by EOW. Meanwhile, let me know two 30-min windows next week for a quick joint review.

Drive (benchmarks & prompt set): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cD3-example-diffs

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Attachments: prompt_set_retailco_v1.jsonl

From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@retailco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@retailco.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:16:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & recommended models / next steps

Thanks Marissa - appreciate the recap. Quick update from our side after a small test run yesterday: after you pushed v2.1 for the shared staging endpoint, our QA team observed a noticeable drop in relevance for about 12 of the 20 seed prompts. Examples attached inline below (copied and redacted):

- Prompt ID 004: previous top-1 relevance 0.92 (v2.0) -> 0.56 (v2.1)
- Prompt ID 011: hallucinated brand name in copy (previously accurate)

This is concerning since a regression of this magnitude will affect conversion. Can we pause the rollout for RetailCo (we're on the managed canary you mentioned) and pin us back to the previous model version while you investigate? We need a short-term mitigation before we move forward with the evaluation.

Thanks,
Sam Taylor
Head of Product, Recommendations
RetailCo
sam.taylor@retailco.com

Inline examples: (see attached eval_results_v2.1_vs_v2.0.csv)

Top ask: can engineering provide a quick diff between v2.1 and v2.0 on your prompt set and, if a regression is confirmed, pin RetailCo back to v2.0 for safety while we investigate? Also, please advise expected timeline for the pin/rollback (hours).

Rishi / Monica - high level: customer observed quality drop on 12/20 seed prompts after v2.1. RetailCo is on managed canary for the rollout. Sam asked to pause/pin back to v2.0. Please confirm next steps and ETA; we should aim for rollback within 24-48h if engineering confirms regression.

I'll coordinate approvals once we have the rollback window.

- Marissa

Attachments: eval_results_v2.1_vs_v2.0.csv

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@retailco.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@retailco.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 14:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Model regression after v2.1 rollout - initial analysis & mitigation plan

Thanks for the context - I dug into the diffs using the prompt set you attached. Initial findings:

- Root cause (likely): a tokenizer tweak and an attention-normalization change introduced in v2.1 that improves long-form generation but slightly shifts ranking behavior on short prompts. The change affects logits distribution for short-context reranking use cases.
- Quant: on your 20 prompts, average top-1 relevance dropped from 0.87 (v2.0) to 0.64 (v2.1). We see concentrated drops on prompts with short queries and heavy product-attribute matching.

Immediate mitigation options:
1) Pin RetailCo traffic back to redwood-open-llama-13b-quant:v2.0 (safe rollback) - low-risk, immediate.
2) Apply a targeted inference flag to emulate v2.0 tokenizer behavior for short contexts (experimental, 24-48h to validate).
3) Patch v2.1 to restore ranking behavior (requires model engineering work; ETA 5-7 days).

Suggested path: execute option (1) now to stop further impact, then run option (2) in staging while we build the patch. If RetailCo approves, we can schedule a rollback window tonight (UTC) and pin you to v2.0 until patch is ready.

I uploaded diffs + a small analysis CSV to the Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cD3-example-diffs (file: eval_results_v2.1_vs_v2.0.csv). Also attaching the short runbook for rollback (rollback_runbook.md).

Operational notes for Monica / ops: rolling RetailCo back to v2.0 is a config change on the routing layer; impact is zero-downtime if we route traffic and rehydrate caches. We should schedule a 30-min window to warm caches before traffic flip.

-Rishi
Principal Inference Engineer
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Attachments: eval_results_v2.1_vs_v2.0.csv, rollback_runbook.md

- Rollback window: Thu, 27 May 2027 02:00 - 02:30 UTC (low traffic for RetailCo).
- Prep: 30-min cache warm at 01:30 UTC.
- Owners: Monica (ops lead) / Rishi (eng support) / Marissa (customer comms).

Checklist for the window:

- Execute routing pin to v2.0; run smoke tests on canary (5% traffic for 10m).
- Scale to 100% for RetailCo if smoke is green.

Sam - please confirm you approve the above window or suggest an alternate. Once you confirm, I'll create the internal change ticket and schedule PagerDuty coverage.

Best,
Monica Patel
